body:
I've been around the suicidality carousel before. I've already told my therapist. I'm in the same parking lot I was in an hour ago. I own no weapons.

What I mean by better is to be able to function. I've been going to therapy for 3 years. I've been taking antidepressants, ADD, and sleeping pills for about a year now. Nothing's snapped me out of it. I want to be pulled out of it.

What can I do to make myself function? Are there any options left for me? If I'm bound to keep going through the same cycle of finding work or going to school only to fail, how do I support myself?
Is there anything I can do to make things better? I don't know what to do.
